scope: Fourteen uploaded report snapshots; no attached script executed; no driver or app changed
privacy: No SSIDs, network addresses, USB serials or raw logs copied into these artifacts
limitations: Twelve report groups were reported working by user; local link/IPv4/received traffic evidence corroborates that status but cannot prove internet or sustained performance
All captured loaded binaries are build55; findings are not build57/build59 hardware-validation evidence
Counters are cumulative; deltas compare same controller registry ID within each bundle
No control request diagnostic results in these app48 bundles
Separate samples may share VID:PID; physical/retail model/revision identity is not established by descriptors
No total successful TX-packet counter is published in selected registry diagnostics; TX-rate reports/requests are not payload counters
Per-frame errors/discards can coexist with working links; e.g. 2357:010C has new CCMP replay/decrypt/input-error increments
Error counters can overlap (the same rejected frame can increment multiple counters), so do not sum them as unique packet drops
The implemented legacy/HT20 path is distinct from a product/silicon marketing maximum; no throughput load test was included
All13 present-controller before/after pairs have even, advancing publication generations and nondecreasing monotonic markers; IORegistry reads remain non-atomic
